setup.intro: Install and manage Klipper-ecosystem components for this printer.
setup.writesDisabled: Install, update and remove are disabled on this host. Use the filamind-setup CLI, or enable them on the host.

overview.title: Managing components
overview.body: Browse the catalog by group; each component shows whether it's installed. Install, update and remove run on the printer host and stay disabled here until you enable them — the filamind-setup CLI can always do it.
